title.zh: 修订第3625号共和国法（即《将伊洛伊洛省Leon市镇的Leon中学改设为国立农业中学并授权为此拨款》）的法案
title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act Numbered Thirty-Six Hundred Twenty-Five, Entitled "An Act Converting the Leon High School in the Municipality of Leon, Province of Iloilo, Into a National Agricultural High School and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor."
title.orig: An Act Amending Republic Act Numbered Thirty-Six Hundred Twenty-Five, Entitled "An Act Converting the Leon High School in the Municipality of Leon, Province of Iloilo, Into a National Agricultural High School and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor."

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5552_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section one of Republic Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred twenty-five is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. Leon Regional High School in the Munic­ipality of Leon, Province of Iloilo, is hereby converted into a national agricultural high school and this school shall continue to be located at its present site in the Municipality of Leon, Province of Iloilo."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
